tools.name: analyze_startup
tools.title: Analyze startup idea
tools.description: Run a FailWise founder-intelligence analysis on a startup idea or company. Returns a risk score (0-100), a verdict, five dimension scores (market demand, competition, pricing, distribution, founder advantage), a failure breakdown, a pre-mortem timeline, and a rebuild plan.

idea.description: The startup idea, product concept, or company name to analyze.

lang.description: Output language. 'en' (default) for English, 'tr' for Turkish.
